steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: I'm the Dancer's protector, my name is <color=#fb9259>Void</color>.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Are you here to banish me too?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: There's no need, you can't do anything. Plus, now...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: I'd rather watch her dance quietly. Why don't you join me?
The Void Puppet takes a step forward and stands right beside you, staring at Hamel quietly. You look at it silently. Indeed, you can't do anything, but this one looks like... it's willing to talk.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Beautiful, isn't it? Once you see her dance, your heart regains peace.
Give my companions back to me.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: They're only captured by the trauma in their own hearts. If you promise to leave, I can send you all back.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: But... You're all so sad already, why don't you stay and watch her for a while?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Hamel comforts everyone and soothes their pain and fear. She does that all the time, leading us out of our trauma.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: By trauma, do you mean DisSea Explosion?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Maybe. Actually I don't quite remember.
Its gaze is indecipherable.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The Fear Puppet can't forget its fear, so it hides in its shell to escape from its nightmares. The Misery Puppet can't forget its misery, so the only way it can survive is through self-punishment.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: As for me, I don't remember anything, and I just don't find meaning in anything. No matter how you try to escape or struggle free from it, in the face of a massive disaster, all the pride of human beings is ultimately vulnerable.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: If there was indeed a great explosion, then all it left me was a feeling of emptiness...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Those who come to the Carnival all have a dark hollow in their hearts. We just want to forget for a while, trying to fill it with all these confetti, music, and the carnival.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: No, no matter how intense the pleasure, it belongs to others. Once the clamorous music stops, we're left on our own again, feeling even emptier inside.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The carnival cannot stop, we want to keep on reveling, but it can't replace everything we've lost. Fear, pain, emptiness, insanity... All these emotions, constantly surging and surging...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The more we want to forget, the more deeply we get trapped in them... Slowly, we don't even remember ourselves anymore. Only that hollow keeps getting bigger and bigger...
It's contamination, it's Mania. Are they under the influence of the Carnival Black Ring too? Or is that a first sign of a Black Ring eruption?
In any case, although still sentient, this puppet's spirit is already tattered.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is only an illusory carnival, it can't save anyone.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: I know, only she can save us...
He looks at Hamel in an infatuated manner.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The most beautiful dancer in the DisCity, a real prodigy, she is art itself, she is the idol everyone pursues.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The most glamorous stage was prepared for her. The most luxurious flowers and wine surrounded her. She's been lifted to the clouds. But even so, she still loves us...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: All our unspeakable sorrow, all our inexpressible pain, she understands everything and empathizes with us, mourning on behalf of us with her dance.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: When the carnival was in full swing, with the sky glowing red, people started carousing and tussling. I saw my body going contorted, and when I thought everything was going to end in this madness... Hamel showed up.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: She said that... she would stay, and that she was willing to dance for us. She's never stopped ever since, she's kept on dancing. She dances for us, healing our fear, pain, and emptiness.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: It's she who ended that red inferno and created the beautiful Carnival.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Does she think so? Do you guys understand her?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The Dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We'll be her audience.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: We praise the park she's created.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is only an illusion created by her.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: So what? We've already seen annihilation long ago. There was only insanity in this world. She's taken us out of the abyss, only she can bring us redemption.

You suddenly realize the lakeside has become fully lined with mascots who have returned from the parade. Among them, there are clowns with tear-smudged makeup, mascots gasping for air, and even more people tainted by contamination.

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: I'm scared... The nightmares have returned... I'm scared...

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: I feel so lonely... I'm all by myself, I feel so lonely...

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: I'm lost, I've lost my way home... Help me...

steps.speaker: Audience
steps.content: Dance for me... Hamel... We love you...
Hamel doesn't answer. The ripples produced by the tips of her toes have spread under their feet. Everything around the lake of the illusory realm moves at her command.
The dense mist transforms into fantastical jellyfish which follow her twirling dance and drift to the audience, peeling the grayness off their bodies bit by bit.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: This is the last bit of redemption we have left. Don't take her away...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Otherwise, no matter who it is, I will banish them.
As he speaks, he turns back and takes out his black cane.
A whining mascot barges into the crowd. Black flames have been ignited on his body—the flames of the accomplices behind the plot in the square, those men in black raincoats.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Someone is trying to harm Hamel... Are they your companions?
